name: Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a half cup of the pasta water, then drain. Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat and cook the minced garlic for 1 minute. Pour in the heavy cream and simmer gently for 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in the grated Parmesan until smooth, then add the pasta and toss, adding a splash of pasta water if the sauce is too thick. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with chopped parsley.
